issues.issue: Is the claimant's rehabilitation relevant to whether he is excluded under article 1F(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says his rehabilitation since coming to Canada should be considered in deciding whether he is excluded.
issues.result_quote: Under Canadian law, as it presently exists, the question of rehabilitation is not relevant

issues.issue: Did the claimant commit a serious non-political crime before coming to Canada, so as to be excluded?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant does not dispute the US cocaine conviction or that it would be a serious non-political crime in Canada.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says the US conspiracy conviction is a serious non-political crime, so the claimant is excluded under art. 1F(b).
issues.result_quote: the Tribunal concludes that XXXXX XXXXX is excluded from consideration as a Convention refugee by reason of the application of article 1F(b)
